divisions.title: Oracles Against the Nations
divisions.theme: God judges all peoples, including Israel
divisions.summary: The lion roars from Zion. Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom, Ammon, Moab, Judah, and finally Israel stand condemned for covenant violations and crimes against humanity.

divisions.title: Judgment Against Israel
divisions.summary: You only have I known of all the families of the earth. Israel's election intensifies her guilt. Religious ritual without justice is an abomination. Prepare to meet your God.

divisions.title: Visions and Hope
divisions.theme: Judgment is certain, but restoration awaits
divisions.summary: Five visions of doom: locusts, fire, plumb line, summer fruit, altar struck. Amaziah confronts Amos. Yet the book closes with David's fallen tent raised and abundance overflowing.
